payload.reason: The evidence clearly defines the source and target domains in the context of domain adaptation, specifically in sentiment classification.

claims.text: The source domain is the existing domain with sufficient labeled data, while the target domain is the new domain with few or no labeled data.
Data in the source and target domains are drawn from different distributions, which is a key challenge in domain adaptation.
The aim of domain adaptation is to learn domain-invariant feature representations to adapt classifiers from the source domain to the target domain.
